boss_intro: Mmm. A guest. How lovely. Do try to keep sight of me.
The lighthouse sleeps. The shadows don't.
Softly now. This dance goes quickly.
taunt: Over here. No — here. Keep up, dear.
You chase beautifully. Uselessly, but beautifully.
The dark is simply light that's shy.
hit_react: A touch! How did you… interesting.
low_hp: You've learned the light too well.
My shadow betrays me… clever, clever beam.
defeat_freed: Caught. By a straight line of light. Of course. It was always going to be light.
The Cog slips away… and I am my own shadow again. Thank you, little sun.
You aimed the beam and read my shadow. That is *seeing*, dear. Rare gift.
